invariant: ADR-0100's credential channels at the engine: `encryptSecretFields` encrypts a `secret` value through the ICryptoProvider into a `sys_secret` row and stores only the opaque ref, and fails CLOSED (throws) with no provider or no `sys_secret` store, never persisting cleartext; a `password` value is stored as-is; an echoed mask is dropped, `""` is refused, `null` clears. The read path masks both (`maskSecretFields`) and then OMITS `internal: true` fields (`omitInternalFields`), the stricter disposition last; the only way back to a value is the three named privileged verbs (`resolveSecret`, `resolveSecretField`, `resolveInternalField`), each refusing a field outside its own channel. ADR-0128 D1: both the encrypt and the decrypt here name the object-secret-field producer's own scope (`object_secret_field`), so no other producer's ciphertext opens through this path; never borrow another producer's scope.
